scope: Desktop SRR design basis. No field survey, operational authorization or statistical traffic calibration.

sources.finding: Port identifies 67 ft (20.42 m) closed lift-span clearance at its stated average river height, 246 ft horizontal clearance, and pool-level dependence. Supports using the identified lifting span, not adjacent unassessed spans.
Port identifies Bingen ramp/harbor and prohibits overnight parking. Overnight recovery needs independent transport arrangements.

Stevenson launch is on Cascade Avenue. Seasonal loading docks are described for May through October; winter recovery cannot assume those docks. Search-index text was accessible; direct page fetch was unavailable.
Viento provides Columbia River access. This establishes a survey candidate, not navigable approach or casualty retention.
County identifies Home Valley Park and its address; supports an intermediate access-sector survey.
County code 12.04.290 identifies Wind River and Drano launch/parking permit requirements. Access does not establish autonomous landing permission.
WDFW identifies intense fishing use and launch traffic at Drano. This supports rejecting it as a default impaired-recovery destination pending a separate entrance/traffic assessment.
Hood River lifting span is LNAM 0226241BDFAB1596, closed vertical clearance 20.4 m, horizontal clearance 74.9 m. Updated route crosses it twice and excludes other bridge footprints.
